mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_requests, COALESCE( ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE response_status LIKE '2%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 0 ) AS success_rate, COALESCE(AVG(execute_time), 0) AS avg_server_duration_ms FROM access_log WHERE access_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{days} * INTERVAL '1 day') AND request_uri NOT LIKE '/api/v1/response-metrics/%'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS frontend_sample_count, COALESCE(AVG(client_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_client_duration_ms, COALESCE( percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY client_duration_ms), 0 ) AS p95_client_duration_ms FROM frontend_response_metric WHERE occurred_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{days} * INTERVAL '1 day')

SELECT CASE WHEN #{days} <= 2 THEN date_trunc('hour', access_time) ELSE date_trunc('day', access_time) END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS request_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(response_status, '') NOT LIKE '2%') AS error_count, COALESCE(AVG(execute_time), 0) AS avg_server_duration_ms FROM access_log WHERE access_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{days} * INTERVAL '1 day') AND request_uri NOT LIKE '/api/v1/response-metrics/%' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT CASE WHEN #{days} <= 2 THEN date_trunc( 'hour', occurred_at AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TIMEZONE') ) ELSE date_trunc( 'day', occurred_at AT TIME ZONE current_setting('TIMEZONE') ) END AS bucket, COALESCE(AVG(client_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_client_duration_ms FROM frontend_response_metric WHERE occurred_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{days} * INTERVAL '1 day') GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT route_pattern, method, COUNT(*) AS request_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS error_count, COALESCE(AVG(server_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_server_duration_ms, COALESCE(AVG(client_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_client_duration_ms, COALESCE( percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY client_duration_ms), 0 ) AS p95_client_duration_ms FROM frontend_response_metric WHERE occurred_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{days} * INTERVAL '1 day') GROUP BY route_pattern, method ORDER BY p95_client_duration_ms DESC LIMIT #{limit}
